text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — the fixture was built by hand, not captured from Jira**

New: The author changed the description to "Part of #16189" and added a screenshot. The fixture explanation says it was "constructed" from Atlassian's API spec and existing fixtures, not captured from a real Jira payload. Missing: a payload captured from a real Jira instance (e.g. via webhook.site), which the fixture guidelines require.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; laurynmm, who gave the feedback, can confirm the fixture needs replacing.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, @huriazahra! The fixture still needs to be a payload captured from a real Jira instance (for example via webhook.site), not one built by hand from the API spec; see the [fixture guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/incoming-webhooks-walkthrough.html#fixture-guidelines). Please replace it with a captured payload, update the test and screenshot to match, and describe how you captured it.
```
